description: Narrated QA loom for UI work: record a UI QA pass with agent-browser and a timestamped step log, voice it with ElevenLabs, burn one-line subtitles with ffmpeg, and embed the narrated mp4 (plus an optional GIF preview) in the PR as GitHub user attachments. Use on UI-changing PRs and UI QA passes. Layers on the `qa` and `agent-browser` skills. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, ffmpeg with libass, and agent-browser.
name: qa-loom
title: QA Loom
